title: Finite-free roof calculation for local evaluation
statement: Under the hypotheses of local homology evaluation, after choosing the finite-free zero-differential quasi-isomorphism roof E <- L -> F(T), the restricted evaluation morphism is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Let O be over-V restriction and A the over-open equivalence. Their composite is naturally isomorphic to scheme-open restriction. Use the proved moduleOverFunctor_limits_proof and moduleOverFunctor_colimits_proof from DerivedHomMayerVietoris for both opens, and Mathlib preservation under composition and natural isomorphism, to make F exact. Mathlib mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso and map_isZero then prove F(J) has zero homology outside degree zero.

Apply finiteFreeZero_homologyEvaluation to E and F(J) to get f, its invertibility, c, and both cycle identities. Apply homologyEvaluation_roof_comparison to e and the roof with these identities to get isomorphisms a,b and the evaluation square.
The right side a.hom composed with f is invertible. Rewrite the square to make the restricted evaluation composed with b.hom invertible, then cancel b.hom using Mathlib IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right.

proof_origin.description: Lean decomposition into a finite-model calculation and an independent restriction/roof naturality square; exactness of two-step restriction and cancellation proved in the item.

theorem homologyEvaluation_local_iso_of_roof (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    (T J : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ) (n : ℤ)
    (hJ : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → IsZero (J.homology k))
    (e : (homComplex (R := X.sheaf) T J).homology n ⟶
      SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf) (T.homology (-n)) (J.homology 0))
    (he : IsHomologyEvaluation X T J n e) (V : X.Opens) (W : V.toScheme.Opens)
    (hI : CochainComplex.IsKInjective ((moduleOpenOverComplexFunctor X V W).obj J))
    (E L : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules (V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.over W)) ℤ)
    (q : L ⟶ (moduleOpenOverComplexFunctor X V W).obj T)
    (p : L ⟶ E) (hq : QuasiIso q) (hp : QuasiIso p)
    (hzero : ∀ a b : ℤ, E.d a b = 0)
    (hsupp : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ k : ℤ, k < a ∨ b < k → IsZero (E.X k))
    (hfree : ∀ k : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (E.X k ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.over W) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) :
    IsIso (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map e).over W)
